item.title: Week 11: Ravens at Panthers
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CAR -2.5 · O/U 43.5 | Model CAR 52% vs. market 56% | Baltimore's offense has to manufacture chunk plays, and that is hard when it ranks near the bottom in explosive play rate at 8.3% against a Carolina defense allowing just 7.6%.
